description: Catalog routing boundaries for overlapping Meteor data, build, view-layer, migration, security, and testing requests.

cases.prompt: Configure MongoDB change streams for selected Meteor collections and explain the include and exclude rules.

expected.behavior: Own the Mongo observer configuration without redirecting an application API question into deployment topology.

cases.prompt: Our deployed Meteor app uses MongoDB Atlas and still polls. Review the production connection and observer configuration, including MONGO_OPLOG_URL or change streams.

expected.behavior: Start with deployment topology and environment configuration, then use Mongo guidance for observer selection details.

cases.prompt: Create a Meteor React client skeleton and configure its Rspack build so imported SVG files become React components.

expected.behavior: Own the React scaffold and React-specific loader decision while handing generic Rspack mechanics to the build skill.

cases.prompt: Configure aliases, source maps, and split chunks in a Meteor Rspack app that has no selected UI framework.

expected.behavior: Keep framework-neutral bundler work in the modern build skill without loading a view-layer skill.

cases.prompt: My Blaze template causes a full page reload after every edit under Rspack. Diagnose the Blaze integration and hot-update boundary.

expected.behavior: Start from Blaze lifecycle behavior and use generic build guidance only for the Rspack integration surface.

cases.prompt: Upgrade a Meteor 2 Blaze application that relies on Fibers and synchronous Mongo calls to Meteor 3 while preserving template reactivity.

expected.behavior: Own the cross-cutting async migration first, then apply Blaze-specific reactive boundaries without suggesting a React rewrite.

cases.prompt: Implement a Meteor method that validates input, authorizes the caller, derives ownership server-side, and uses async Mongo APIs.

expected.behavior: Route RPC construction to methods while allowing security guidance for broader trust-boundary review.

cases.prompt: A Meteor React page renders user HTML and our CSP still allows unsafe-inline. Replace the unsafe rendering and tighten the policy.

expected.behavior: Own sanitization and CSP as security outcomes, with React as implementation context only.

cases.prompt: Write an integration test for a Meteor publication that verifies authorization, ready state, and removed messages over a DDP connection.

expected.behavior: Own the test harness and assertions in testing, with publication semantics as supporting domain guidance.

cases.prompt: Choose and implement the publication strategy for a high-churn collection, including merge-box tradeoffs and stop cleanup.

expected.behavior: Route publication lifecycle and merge behavior to pubsub while allowing Mongo query guidance as a secondary concern.

cases.prompt: Migrate an existing Meteor app from the legacy bundler to Rspack, translating its custom loaders and checking package compatibility.

expected.behavior: Own the ordered migration and compatibility checks, then use generic build guidance for the resulting configuration.

cases.prompt: A new framework-neutral Meteor 3.4 app wants current Rspack configuration helpers. Which capabilities are available at this Meteor version and what fallbacks apply?

expected.behavior: Answer a version-sensitive build configuration question without inventing a migration or view-layer scope.
